ruling.recommended_action: Refund the off-route extra-distance component of the metered fare (SGD 4.90) to the rider as a Ryde voucher; no account flag required.

segment_findings.reason: GPS trace leaves the quoted optimal route after 22:57:25 and rejoins near 23:01:25, taking the Central Expressway/Keppel corridor (~2.4 km of trace) instead of the optimal route's ~1.15 km for the same endpoints — an unexplained extra ~1.2 km (RD-1). No rider request or pre-departure agreement appears in chat (RD-5 fails). Driver cites AYE congestion but there is no traffic incident on the optimal route (RD-4(a) fails) and the only AYE band-1 record covers a link between his rejoin points, not the substituted stretch (RD-4(b) is corroborative only) → not exempt.

rejected_claims.reason: RD-4 justification rejected: the incidents list is empty (no LTA incident on the substituted optimal-route segment), and the band-1 AYE record (SYN-1002, ends 22:57:40) does not cover the CE/SYN-0007 stretch the driver bypassed; a speed band cannot exempt a segment on its own (RD-4(b), G3).
